<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="ex45012023-03-0116-11-03" type="excerpt" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:mtshan_nyid"> <milestone unit="section" n="1321.121.11 mtshan nyid"/>
           dang po ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3887">'jam pa'i rdo rje</rs> na re | rang ldog rdzas ma grub kyi mtshan nyid ni | 
           <app><lem wit="inst:4770">chos gang zhig</lem><rdg wit="inst:4770">chos gang zhig</rdg><rdg wit="inst:5593">chos kyi gang zhig</rdg></app> 
           mtshan gzhi la ji ltar bkod pa ltar grub cing don ldog  
           <app>
            <lem wit="inst:5593">rkyang</lem><rdg wit="inst:5593">rkyang</rdg><rdg wit="inst:4770">kyang</rdg></app> 
            par ma grub <lb edRef="inst:4770" n="14b8"/> pa'o zhe na |
            bum pa dngos po'i tha snyad du mtshon pa la ba lang gi tha snyad mtshan nyid du bkod pa de rang ldog rdzas ma grub ma yin <lb edRef="inst:5593" n="12a4"/> par thal | gzhi la grub ma tshang pa'i phyir | 'dod na rang ldog rdzas yod du thal lo || des na rang ldog rdzas ma grub kyi mtshan nyid ni chos gang zhig don ldog <app><lem wit="inst:5593">rkyang</lem><rdg wit="inst:5593">rkyang</rdg><rdg wit="inst:4770">kyang</rdg></app> par ma grub <lb edRef="inst:4770" n="14b9"/> pa'o ||</seg></TEI>
